item.title: [+1] India opens anti-dumping probe into caprolactam imports from China, Russia, Thailand and the US
item.description:
Caprolactam is a nylon raw material. The probe follows other trade-defence moves; Bangladesh separately asked India to lift anti-dumping duties. New.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild tailwind (+1) — Protection for chemical makers

Why it matters: Possible duties would protect domestic chemical makers' prices while raising input costs for nylon yarn and textile users.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
